draft_en.body:
Hi Berk,

Thanks for coming back. Straight answer, so you do not have to chase me again: the Marvell-based managed units are priced where you saw them - that line does not move, and for projects where the end customer always picks the cheapest 10/100 unit it is the wrong line, you were right about that.

What I can do for those projects is a separate budget line: DIN-rail 10/100 copper + SC fibre, unmanaged, wide DC input, at a fraction of the managed price. If you want it, give me the exact port count (8, 16 or 24 copper), fibre type (multimode 2 km or single-mode 20 km) and whether PoE is still required, and I quote that line in one mail - no catalogue.

One question: is PoE still required, or is it plain 10/100 + fibre now?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
